1. To press the “AL” button, you will find the “ALARM” mode. Then press the “SET” button three times, you will enter the “SNOOZE” mode. If you press the “SET” button four times, you can set the “SOUND” mode. 2. Press the “UP” and “DOWN” button to get the desired value about the time and transform 7 sound modes. 3. To press the “AL” button, you will return to the time display interface. Then press the "AL" button again and enter the “ALARM” mode in order to confirm the state of “ALARM” and “SNOOZE” by pressing the “UP” or “DOWN” button.
What’s the Function of the “TAP” Button?

While you press the “TAP” button to enter the sound play mode, 7 kinds of lights will change constantly for ten minutes. If you want to stop ringing anytime, just press the “TAP” button again. A minute later the alarm clock returns to normal mode.
To set the time and adjust the volume
- The “UP” button is for changing the time pattern between 12 and 24 Hour Format - The “DOWN” button is for switching the temperature unit in °C or °F
1. Press the “SET” button to set the time and date. 2. Press the “UP” button and the “DOWN” button to get the desired value you want
When the alarm goes off, press the "UP" and "DOWN" button to adjust the volume
